claim: The FTC's Trade Regulation Rule on the Use of Consumer Reviews and Testimonials (16 CFR Part 465) is effective October 21, 2024.
evidence: This rule is effective October 21, 2024.

claim: Section 465.2(a) makes it a violation for a business to write, create, or sell a consumer review or testimonial that materially misrepresents the reviewer or their experience.
evidence: for a business to write, create, or sell a consumer review, consumer testimonial, or celebrity testimonial

claim: One prohibited misrepresentation is that the reviewer or testimonialist exists.
evidence: That the reviewer or testimonialist exists;

claim: Section 465.2(b) bars a business from purchasing a consumer review about its products that it knew or should have known materially misrepresented the reviewer or experience.

claim: Section 465.2(c) applies the same prohibition to a business procuring such reviews from its officers, managers, employees, or agents, or any of their immediate relatives, for posting on a third-party platform or website.
